Specification: This module defines a very small TLA+ specification used to check the behavior of a sequence-folding operator from the extended Apalache environment. It declares one integer variable x, initializes it to 0, and then allows only stuttering steps via Next == UNCHANGED x, so the state machine itself is trivial. The interesting part is the invariant-like operator Inv, which asserts the negation of the expected result of folding Append over the sequence <<1,2,3>> starting from the empty sequence; the comment explains that this is intended to test whether the SMT encoding is properly constrained and therefore yields UNSAT.
